resources.string: Enables full voice control and text typing inside third-party apps dynamically.

1. Grant Microphone and Screen Overlay permissions if requested.
2. Enable the service in Accessibility Settings.
3. A glowing AI assistant orb will appear floating on your screen.
4. Drag the orb anywhere. Tap it once to initiate Voice Assist.
5. Try complex sentences like: "Open YouTube and search rock songs and play video".

• "Open YouTube and search Punjabi song and play video"
• "Open WhatsApp and open Rahul chat and type Hello and send"
• "Open Chrome, search for Google, scroll down and click the first result"
• "Scroll Down" / "Scroll Up"
• "Go Back" / "Go Home"
